verdicts.reason: A is mostly a scaled-down copy of the original. The hierarchy and the spacing between headline, details, chips and CTA all hold up, but the chip text and the URL line are small, the lower third is mostly dead space, and the red 'missing asset' placeholder is still there. B has real collisions. The can graphic sits on top of 'Pier 9'. The subtitle is jammed against 'Saturday 21 June' with no gap. All the content is crammed into the top 60% of the canvas, which leaves a large empty bottom half with only the placeholder box in it.
